messages.author: fe85b9636ef30d7c
messages.subject: Error in nlminb
parts:
Dear Yves & lavaan community,

I am trying to put together a model with a composite variable and some ordinal endogenous observed variables, and I am running into the following error:

Error in nlminb(start = theta, objective = .self$minObjective, gradient = .self$minGradient,  : 
  NA/NaN gradient evaluation
In addition: Warning message:
In nlminb(start = theta, objective = .self$minObjective, gradient = .self$minGradient,  :
  NA/NaN function evaluation

I have not been able to decipher this message, and I'm hoping that someone will have a recommendation.

Note: to code for a composite variable, I am using the approach outlined by Jarrett Byrnes.

Here is the script that I am running as well as a snippet of data (attached as a .csv).

#Load the data
read.csv('sample.csv',header=T)

#First I set all of the endogenous ordinal variables as 'ordered'
data$att<-ordered(data$att)
data$b1<-ordered(data$b1)
data$b2<-ordered(data$b2)
data$b3<-ordered(data$b3)

#Next I set exogenous variables as 'numeric' (I kept getting an error when these were integers)
data$age<-as.numeric(data$age)
data$ethnicity<-as.numeric(data$ethnicity)
data$income<-as.numeric(data$income)
data$home<-as.numeric(data$home)
data$credit<-as.numeric(data$credit)
data$farm_ha<-as.numeric(data$farm_ha)
data$vampire<-as.numeric(data$vampire)
data$livestock_n<-as.numeric(data$livestock_n)
data$coffee_ha<-as.numeric(data$coffee_ha)
data$edu<-as.numeric(data$edu)
data$nh<-as.numeric(data$nh)

model<-'

#define outcome as a composite variable
#fix first effect to one to give outcome a scale
outcome~1*b1+b2+b3
#specify zero error variance for outcome
outcome~~0*outcome
#specify a regression between outcome and att using latent variable notation
#use NA to tell lavaan not to fix the effects to one
outcome=~NA*att
#estimate variance of att
att~~att

#specify regressions between b1, b2, and b3 and demographic variables
b1~age+edu+home+nh+ethnicity+credit+livestock_n+coffee_ha+farm_ha+vampire
b2~age+edu+home+nh+ethnicity+credit+livestock_n+coffee_ha+farm_ha+vampire
b3~age+edu+home+nh+ethnicity+credit+livestock_n+coffee_ha+farm_ha+vampire
'

#when i try to run the sem, i get the error message
f3<-sem(m3,data=data,std.lv=T)

Thank you
-Leighton

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Error in nlminb
parts:
On 12/11/2012 10:11 PM, Leighton Reid wrote:
> Dear Yves & lavaan community,
>
> I am trying to put together a model with a composite variable and some
> ordinal endogenous observed variables, and I am running into the
> following error:
>
> Error in nlminb(start = theta, objective = .self$minObjective, gradient
> = .self$minGradient, :
> NA/NaN gradient evaluation
> In addition: Warning message:
> In nlminb(start = theta, objective = .self$minObjective, gradient =
> .self$minGradient, :
> NA/NaN function evaluation

Could you try this again with the dev version of lavaan (0.5-11). I
believe the error is a side-effect of a bug in 0.5-11 where
zero-variances were (annoyingly) set to 1 internally. But his has been
fixed, and it should work.

(in the dev version, there is also no need anymore to change the integer
types to numeric)

BTW, instead of using

outcome=~NA*att
outcome~~0*outcome
outcome~1*b1+b2+b3

you can use the '<~' operator:

outcome <~ 1*b1+b2+b3

Yves.

messages.author: fe85b9636ef30d7c
messages.subject: Re: Error in nlminb
parts:
Thank you, Yves. My model is now working.

Cheers,
Leighton
